question: Five boxes A, B, C, D, and E are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. The box A is not kept above or below box C or E which are kept together. Box B is kept at the third place above box C. There is only one box between box D and E and one of them is kept at the bottom. Which box is kept in the middle?
solution:
**Given:**

Five boxes A, B, C, D, and E are kept one over the other

Arranging the boxes according to the given information:

 
• The box A is not kept above or below box C or E which are kept together.

 
 
• ​We can conclude from here that C and D are together and from this information we can't decide the position of any of three alphabets (C D and A)
 
 
 
• ​ Box B is kept at the third place above box C. 
 
 
• ​As C and B are together , there are two possibiltes that **B** is third above C.
 
• ​
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3eb5770323f95e36b259ee7254c31cba65d515f2110988740d6e7ea219ada2bc.png] 
 
 
 
• There is only one box between box D and E and one of them is kept at the bottom . 
 
 
• ​Two possible positions are there for D
 
 
 
• 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a915a828f851154aaf4757a3b5f67bf9be41c317c5f95080f308141e22c319f8.png] 
 
 
• Case 1 will be rejected as it is not possible.
 
 
 
• ​A will be placed after B and the first point also holds here that A is not above or Below C and E.​
 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da3db07d36d6e542fc262a5c827bb4e7b21300872e0b3cdd76440bafe46c6382.png] 
 
 

 We can conclude from the final arrangement that D is at middle.

**Thus the correct answer id 'D' .**
